capabilities.archival_reason: Repository or package returned HTTP 404/Not Found

tool_signatures.name: change_password
tool_signatures.description: Change a user's password. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode.

tool_signatures.name: copy_file
tool_signatures.description: Copy a file to a new location. In safe mode, destination must be in /tmp or /var/tmp.

tool_signatures.name: create_cron_job
tool_signatures.description: Create a new scheduled cron job. Specify the command to run and the schedule using cron syntax (minutes, hours, days, months, weekdays). Use '*' for 'every' (e.g., '*/5' for every 5 minutes).

tool_signatures.name: create_directory
tool_signatures.description: Create a new directory. In safe mode, only directories in /tmp or /var/tmp can be created.

tool_signatures.name: create_user
tool_signatures.description: Create a new system user. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode.

tool_signatures.name: create_webmin_user
tool_signatures.description: Create a new Webmin user account. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode.

tool_signatures.name: delete_cron_job
tool_signatures.description: Delete a cron job. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode. Use list_cron_jobs to find the job index.

tool_signatures.name: delete_file
tool_signatures.description: Delete a file or empty directory. This is a dangerous operation. In safe mode, only deletes in /tmp and /var/tmp are allowed. System directories are always protected.

tool_signatures.name: delete_user
tool_signatures.description: Delete a system user. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode. Critical system users cannot be deleted.

tool_signatures.name: delete_webmin_user
tool_signatures.description: Delete a Webmin user account. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode. The last superuser account cannot be deleted regardless of safe mode.

tool_signatures.name: disable_service
tool_signatures.description: Disable a service from starting automatically at system boot. Critical services are blocked to prevent boot failures.

tool_signatures.name: edit_cron_job
tool_signatures.description: Edit an existing cron job. Use list_cron_jobs to find the job index. Only specify the fields you want to change.

tool_signatures.name: enable_service
tool_signatures.description: Enable a service to start automatically at system boot.

tool_signatures.name: get_disk_health
tool_signatures.description: Get SMART health status for a specific disk. Returns overall health, temperature, power-on hours, SMART attributes, and any errors or warnings.

tool_signatures.name: get_disk_usage
tool_signatures.description: Get disk usage information for all mounted filesystems. Shows total, used, and free space, plus inode usage.

tool_signatures.name: get_fail2ban_status
tool_signatures.description: Get Fail2ban status for a specific jail or overall. Returns currently banned IPs and ban counts.

tool_signatures.name: get_group_quota
tool_signatures.description: Get quota limits and usage for a specific group on a filesystem.

tool_signatures.name: get_memory_usage
tool_signatures.description: Get memory usage information. Shows total, used, and free memory in KB, MB, and GB, plus buffer and cache usage.

tool_signatures.name: get_mysql_status
tool_signatures.description: Get MySQL server status including version, uptime, connections, and query statistics.

tool_signatures.name: get_network_info
tool_signatures.description: Get network configuration including all interfaces (with IP, MAC, speed), routing table, and default gateway.

tool_signatures.name: get_package_count
tool_signatures.description: Get the total count of installed packages on the system.

tool_signatures.name: get_package_info
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about an installed package including version, description, maintainer, and install date.

tool_signatures.name: get_service_status
tool_signatures.description: Get the status of a specific system service. Returns whether the service is running or stopped.

tool_signatures.name: get_ssh_config
tool_signatures.description: Get SSH server (sshd) configuration settings including port, authentication methods, and security options.

tool_signatures.name: get_system_info
tool_signatures.description: Get comprehensive system information including OS, kernel, CPU, memory, disk usage, and update status. This is a good starting point for understanding system state.

tool_signatures.name: get_system_time
tool_signatures.description: Get the current system time and timezone configuration.

tool_signatures.name: get_user_quota
tool_signatures.description: Get quota limits and usage for a specific user on a filesystem.

tool_signatures.name: get_webmin_user
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed permissions for a specific Webmin user account. Shows which modules the user can access.

tool_signatures.name: get_webmin_version
tool_signatures.description: Get the version of the connected Webmin server. Returns the version string and hostname.

tool_signatures.name: list_available_updates
tool_signatures.description: List all available package updates including security updates. Shows current and new versions for each package.

tool_signatures.name: list_backups
tool_signatures.description: List Webmin configuration backups. Shows available backups that can be restored.

tool_signatures.name: list_banned_ips
tool_signatures.description: List all currently banned IP addresses from Fail2ban.

tool_signatures.name: list_cron_jobs
tool_signatures.description: List all scheduled cron jobs. Shows the schedule, command, user, and whether each job is active.

tool_signatures.name: list_disks
tool_signatures.description: List all physical disks with SMART capability. Shows device path, model, serial number, capacity, and whether SMART is enabled.

tool_signatures.name: list_fail2ban_jails
tool_signatures.description: List all Fail2ban jails and their status. Shows which jails are enabled and their current ban counts.

tool_signatures.name: list_groups
tool_signatures.description: List all system groups. Returns both regular groups (GID >= 1000) and system groups separately, with member information.

tool_signatures.name: list_logical_volumes
tool_signatures.description: List all LVM logical volumes. Shows name, size, volume group, device path, and mount point for each LV.

tool_signatures.name: list_mounts
tool_signatures.description: List all mounted filesystems. Shows mount point, device, filesystem type, and mount options.

tool_signatures.name: list_mysql_databases
tool_signatures.description: List all MySQL databases. Separates user databases from system databases (information_schema, mysql, etc.).

tool_signatures.name: list_mysql_users
tool_signatures.description: List all MySQL users and their host permissions.

tool_signatures.name: list_processes
tool_signatures.description: List all running processes on the system. Shows PID, user, CPU usage, memory, and command for each process.

tool_signatures.name: list_quota_filesystems
tool_signatures.description: List filesystems with disk quota support. Shows which filesystems have quotas enabled and their status.

tool_signatures.name: list_runlevels
tool_signatures.description: List system runlevels and their descriptions.

tool_signatures.name: list_services
tool_signatures.description: List all system services (systemd units or init scripts). Returns service names. Use get_service_status to check if a specific service is running.

tool_signatures.name: list_user_quotas
tool_signatures.description: List all user quotas on a specific filesystem. Shows disk usage, soft/hard limits for blocks and files.

tool_signatures.name: list_users
tool_signatures.description: List all system users. Returns both regular users (UID >= 1000) and system users separately, with details like home directory and shell.

tool_signatures.name: list_volume_groups
tool_signatures.description: List all LVM volume groups. Shows name, total size, free space, physical volume count, and logical volume count for each VG.

tool_signatures.name: list_webmin_logs
tool_signatures.description: List Webmin action/audit logs. Shows recent actions performed through Webmin including user, module, and action details.

tool_signatures.name: list_webmin_modules
tool_signatures.description: List all available Webmin modules that can be assigned to users.

tool_signatures.name: list_webmin_servers
tool_signatures.description: List all configured Webmin servers with their aliases and connection info. Shows which server is the default.

tool_signatures.name: list_webmin_users
tool_signatures.description: List all Webmin user accounts (NOT system users). Shows usernames and which modules each user can access.

tool_signatures.name: modify_user
tool_signatures.description: Modify an existing system user. Only specify fields you want to change.

tool_signatures.name: modify_webmin_user
tool_signatures.description: Modify a Webmin user's permissions or password. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode. Cannot demote the last superuser account.

tool_signatures.name: read_file
tool_signatures.description: Read the contents of a file from the remote system. Can return content as a string or as an array of lines.

tool_signatures.name: rename_file
tool_signatures.description: Rename or move a file. In safe mode, both source and destination must be in /tmp or /var/tmp.

tool_signatures.name: restart_service
tool_signatures.description: Restart a system service. The service will be stopped and then started again. Some critical services (ssh, webmin) may be blocked in safe mode.

tool_signatures.name: set_user_quota
tool_signatures.description: Set disk quota limits for a user on a filesystem. This is a dangerous operation and is blocked in safe mode. Set limits to 0 for unlimited.

tool_signatures.name: start_service
tool_signatures.description: Start a stopped system service. If the service is already running, this is a no-op.

tool_signatures.name: stop_service
tool_signatures.description: Stop a running system service. Critical services (ssh, webmin, systemd services) are blocked to prevent system lockout.

tool_signatures.name: test_server_connection
tool_signatures.description: Test connectivity to a specific Webmin server. Returns version and hostname if successful.

tool_signatures.name: write_file
tool_signatures.description: Write content to a file. This is a dangerous operation. In safe mode, only writes to /tmp and /var/tmp are allowed. System directories (/etc, /bin, /usr, etc.) are always blocked.
